Flowchart TD
A["activateCard(accountId, customerId)"] --> B{"ENDPOINT missing?"}
B -->|"Yes"| C["throw RequestError('ENDPOINT is missing!', 406)"]
B -->|"No"| D["relUrl = ENDPOINT.replace(accountId).replace(customerId)"]
D --> E["apiEp = BASE_URL + relUrl"]
E --> F["res = await xpPut('API_ARN', apiEp, JSON.stringify(accountId, customerId))"]
F --> G{"res.status != 200?"}
G -->|"Yes"| H["throw RequestError(res.data.message, res.status)"]
G -->|"No"| I["data = res.data"]
I --> J["response.statusCode = res.status"]
J --> K["response.status = data.activateStatus.status"]
K --> L["response.confirmationNumber = data.activateStatus.confirmationNumber"]
L --> M["response.referenceNumber = data.activateStatus.referenceNumber"]
M --> N["return response: FinalResponse"]
O[("process.env: ENDPOINT, BASE_URL")] --> B
O --> D
O --> E
P["@ccrlayer/common: xpPut, RequestError"] --> F
P --> C
P --> H
Q["./model: FinalResponse"] --> A
Q --> N

flowchart TD
    Start(["Start: activateCard(accountId, customerId)"]) --> InitResp["response: FinalResponse = {}"]
    InitResp --> CheckEndpoint{"ENDPOINT env var missing?"}
    CheckEndpoint -->|"Yes"| ThrowMissing["throw RequestError('ENDPOINT is missing!', 406)"]
    ThrowMissing --> End1(["End: Exception"])
    CheckEndpoint -->|"No"| BuildRelUrl["relUrl = ENDPOINT.replace('{accountId}', accountId).replace('{customerId}', customerId)"]
    BuildRelUrl --> BuildApiEp["apiEp = BASE_URL + relUrl"]
    BuildApiEp --> CallXpPut["res = await xpPut('API_ARN', apiEp, JSON.stringify({accountId, customerId}))"]
    CallXpPut --> CheckStatus{"res.status != 200?"}
    CheckStatus -->|"Yes"| ThrowError["throw RequestError(res.data.message, res.status)"]
    ThrowError --> End2(["End: Exception"])
    CheckStatus -->|"No"| ExtractData["data = res.data"]
    ExtractData --> SetStatusCode["response.statusCode = res.status"]
    SetStatusCode --> SetStatus["response.status = data.activateStatus.status"]
    SetStatus --> SetConfirmation["response.confirmationNumber = data.activateStatus.confirmationNumber"]
    SetConfirmation --> SetReference["response.referenceNumber = data.activateStatus.referenceNumber"]
    SetReference --> ReturnResp(["Return: response"])
